proposed_capability: P95 Fifth Gear + P67/P62: host-owned, model-independent spatial-perception observations with camera and exact-build binding, per-object evidence provenance, 2D overlap versus attested physical relations, ON_LOT/house zoning and oriented landmark abstention, bounded deterministic evaluator with synthetic and negative fixtures. Integrate as an opt-in read-only host_listener tick sidecar; no Cursor/Codex/Playwright dependency or fake object detection.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only interpretation of supplied capture-bound observations. Never moves mouse/camera or executes game input. Never writes any Sims saves, lots, mods or profiles; click safety remains owned by existing lot_boundary/screen_admit.
expected_outcome: Host frame-to-spatial-relation report, explicit unknown/ambiguous states for wall vs gate and inside/outside, overlapping object support/attachment distinctions, bounded versioned P67 eval with CI and host listener wiring.
negative_tests: No lot orientation inference from raw screen left/right or unanchored view
No world click or navigation permit from a high confidence box
Partial box overlaps are not physically on-top without reviewed scene or contact evidence
Wall versus gate classification conflict must abstain
Street/neighbor sighting must not become on-lot house evidence
Stale camera revision or wrong patch must abstain
Unknown object categories and bad box coordinates fail closed
No Playwright/Cursor/Codex engine requirement in host module
rollback_path: Revert optional spatial_frame sidecar, spatial_perception module, contract, evaluator fixtures, tests and documentation; existing lot_boundary, lot_focus and screen_atlas remain unchanged.
unresolved_unknowns: Real Sims screenshot-trained detector weights and pack/version-specific visual calibrations do not exist in this repo
Live Windows host capture and game-specific precision/recall need operator host observations
Capture-side source labels are untrusted until independently reviewed; explicit detector source cannot grant control
decision_rationale: Operator requests durable host-owned vision reasoning independent from IDE/browser control, and executable evaluator for lot sides, house boundaries, walls/gates and nested/attached small objects. Preserve offline proof ceiling and existing authority.
